newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Riksbank says nearing bottom for repo rate.
newsitem.headline: Riksbank says nearing bottom for repo rate.

text.p: Swedish Riksbank deputy governor Lars Heikensten said on Tuesday the repo rate was gradually nearing the bottom after 25 cuts since January this year.
"We have lowered rates so much that it is obvious that we will gradually come closer to the bottom," Heikensten told a press conference.
On Tuesday, the Riksbank cut the repo rate by 25 basis points to 4.10 percent. The repo started the year at 8.91 percent and this was the 25th cut in 1996.
Its other key interest rates, the deposit and lending rates, currently stands at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
